job: Make imported quote evidence fail closed against its stored bytes and bind a current quote response to the exact prepared RFQ when one was used, while preserving legacy and explicitly unlinked quotes.

outputs.acceptance: A new quote preserves the version-two budget basis and carries either both rfqId/rfqHash or two explicit nulls. Version-one and version-two records remain readable and visibly legacy-unbound.
Quote validation decodes the stored original, checks media type, exact byte size and SHA-256 against the bytes, and refuses any mismatch.
Reconciliation reports matched, not-linked, missing, changed or legacy-unbound RFQ state without hiding line mappings, allowances, omissions or budget drift.
The local quote form lets the user select a prepared RFQ or explicitly keep the quote unlinked; no file is parsed into commercial claims and nothing is sent.

dependsOn.evidence: Exact implementation commit 4131a5214049549a03255b650efc8a3cc30fb28f passed focused, browser, type and 607-test gates.
Current quote records already retain line mapping, allowances, omissions and one original evidence record, but do not recompute evidence integrity or link the response to an RFQ.
Current quote reconciliation already explains design and complete budget-basis drift.

rejectionGates: Reject if any landing-scene, Three.js, animation, model, meadow, tree, sky, mountain, shader, camera, lighting, builder geometry, plan catalog, GLB or generated-plan asset changes.
Reject if a quote can store only one of rfqId/rfqHash, or if a linked quote can display as matched when its RFQ is absent or its canonical hash differs.
Reject if evidence validation checks only checksum syntax; the decoded original bytes, byte count, media type and SHA-256 must agree.
Reject if old version-one or version-two quotes are overwritten, silently upgraded or discarded.
Reject if an unlinked quote is presented as an RFQ response or if missing evidence is presented as verified evidence.
Reject if file content is interpreted into prices, terms or scope automatically; line mapping remains a human action.
Reject if any quote is sent, uploaded, accepted or used for payment, or if any external provider, legal, deployment, HOMES or infrastructure gate is crossed.

verify.freshContextVerifier: A verifier that did not implement Q05A must inspect the final stable snapshot when delegation is authorized.

anchors: One changed byte, byte count, media type or checksum makes original quote evidence invalid.
A current linked quote records the exact RFQ id and canonical hash and reconciles as matched only against that record.
Changed and missing RFQ records remain visible; explicit null linkage remains not-linked; v1/v2 remain legacy-unbound.
Line mappings, allowances, omissions, design drift and budget drift retain their existing behavior.
No changed path is under the frozen 3D, animation, model, meadow, worker, drawing-engine or builder-geometry sets.

repair.scope: Only Q05A quote versioning, evidence integrity, RFQ-link reconciliation, local capture UI or focused tests may be repaired. A second failure returns the node to blocked.

results: Focused quote evidence and RFQ-link contract: 5/5 passed.
